Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ie-core-ihi-record-status-codes

This case-insensitive code system http://iehr.ai/fhir/ie/core/CodeSystem/ie-core-ihi-record-status-codes defines the following codes:

CodeDefinition
provisional Provisional Individual Healthcare Identifier status for individuals presenting to a healthcare facility as unconscious or incapacitated, and unknown to the healthcare facility. Provisional Individual Healthcare Identifiers will expire after 90 days unless the status is changed.
unverified Unverified Individual Healthcare Identifier status where the information associated with the Individual Healthcare Identifier has not been confirmed through an Evidence of Identity process.
verified Verified Individual Healthcare Identifier status where the information associated with the Individual Healthcare Identifier has been confirmed through an Evidence of Identity process.

name: IECoreIndividualHealthcareIdentifierRecordStatusCodes
title: IE Core Individual Healthcare Identifier Record Status
description: The Individual Healthcare Identifier Record Status code system defines concepts that may be used to describe the classification status of a record of an Individual Healthcare Identifier.
